notes.title: Only 2 days left until the journey begins! Official launch is on the 24/02th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40867475/a414df37215940cc5ebec5c88c301d23c6b14e2d.gif[/img]

In a peculiar and macabre universe, little Arthur faces his greatest fears, nightfall is what scares him the most, in this brief period of darkness his syndromes transcend the limits of the psychic, monsters are always on the prowl, will this time he will escape ?

There were long months working to develop this incredible game, and you cannot stay out of this journey, in the beginning nothing will be easy, but you will have to overcome your challenges.

Add this amazing game to your wishlist now!
